entries.photo_prompt: Leave as is, except for the windows. Darken them slightly, possibly by applying a gradient mask and/or a layer mask and/or more slight exposure adjustment.
Lift shadows ever so slightly, add warmth without blowing highlights.

A dreamlike, cinematic feel. The Scene has a gentle glow, using gentle bloom and soft-peak luminosity that blurs the edges slightly. Sunlight refracts through atmospheric haze, creating a warm, incandescent atmosphere. Any water reflects the diffused light, rendered with a Pro-mist filter effect to prioritize clarity over warmth. Shot on Kodak Portra 35mm with visible volumetric light.
Diffuse slight edges, so anything neon feels glowing, almost dripping with light. Shot on a Cinestill 800T film.
Anything neon glows and surges with light. Shot on a Cinestill 800T film.
